note: *** CHAIN DEAD BY DESIGN FAULT: the chain wires each die top-left to top-right pad. With the dice rotated 90 deg those are the RED CATHODE and BLUE CATHODE, and the real anode (bottom-left) is left floating. Every die is therefore two back-to-back diodes, so the chain cannot conduct in either direction and cannot generate a net photovoltage. Measured: OL in resistance mode, 0 V under illumination. NOT a bond failure. ***
